scope: Provincial highway structures only, and not a complete set of crossings. City-owned and TransLink crossings are absent, including the Burrard, Granville, Cambie, Arthur Laing, Knight Street, Moray, Dinsmore and No. 2 Road bridges; no openly licensed layer holding them has been found. The Pattullo is absent too: the province's own major-bridge record for it sits about 20 km away near the international boundary, and the only correctly placed Pattullo geometry in the layer is flagged for deletion. A map that presented this as the crossings would overstate isolation.
